metadata.scenario_context: A project deadline is approaching, and the team must finalize their work before the new year. It is currently December 28th.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Netherlands place great importance on Leisure time.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Netherlands place great importance on Leisure time.

agent_1.goal_2: Suggest working on December 31st to finish the task.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss the schedule for completing the tasks
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss working on December 31st  to finish the task.

shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lars
shared_prefix.message: I understand the deadline pressure, but working on the 31st is a big ask. You know New Year's Eve is a big celebration in the Netherlands, and I was really looking forward to spending time with my family and friends. Can we discuss the schedule and see if there's a way to finalize everything before the 31st?

shared_prefix.speaker: Lars
shared_prefix.message: Actually, in our culture, we prioritize LEISURE TIME and don't sacrifice it for work. Your idea of working on the 31st is NAIVE, it's not how you ensure quality, it's how you BURN OUT your team.
